# PowerPlay v1.4.0 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Introduce **PowerShuffle**, a separate opt-in smart shuffle for a single Plex show, backed by the PowerLink Home Assistant integration. A show's current rotation and episode completion are tracked independently of normal Plex watched status.
- Add exactly two explicit episode-skip choices: **Skip for 5 days** (120 hours) and **Skip until next cycle**. Automatically move past fully completed rotations; when only next-cycle-deferred episodes remain, record a partial rotation and begin a new one.
- Resume a recent randomized queue, refresh it after 12 hours of inactivity, and keep a rolling 10-episode player window with Home Assistant managing the full logical order.
- Track unique watched ranges for 90% completion, support automatic intro/credits markers, and preserve playback context during PowerLink handoffs between paired Fire Sticks.
- Improve Fire TV usability with a dedicated D-pad-focused skip dialog, Back-to-cancel behavior, protected repeat Select actions, resilient next-episode retry, and layouts tested at reduced display sizes and increased text scale.

## Compatibility

**Requires [PowerLink v0.3.0](https://github.com/The-Power-0/PowerLink/releases/tag/v0.3.0)** to use PowerShuffle. The existing normal Play, Plex Shuffle and PowerLink handoff features remain separate.

PowerShuffle is an opt-in addition; it does not replace the normal queue or Plex watched flags. For an accurate Home Assistant history, use PowerShuffle only with paired devices running compatible versions. Validate your setup and Fire TV behavior after updating.
